states.name: after_check_1
states.description: Pool scene is loaded and a mesh with pool geometry or material is present in the scene

states.name: after_check_2
states.description: Carbon fibre overlay texture is loaded and applied to a screen-space quad or post-process pass

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: Bloom post-processing pass exists and has a configurable strength/intensity property

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: Chromatic aberration post-process effect is present with an adjustable offset parameter

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: Slider UI controls exist for bloom, chromatic aberration, vignette, exposure, and saturation (at least 5 range inputs)

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: Adjusting the bloom slider updates bloom pass strength and inversely adjusts vignette strength (energy conservation law)

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: Carbon fibre overlay opacity toggle or slider exists and changing it modifies the overlay material opacity

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: Undo button exists and clicking it reverts the last slider change

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: Redo button exists and clicking it re-applies a previously undone change

states.name: after_check_10
states.description: Tone-mapping exposure slider changes the renderer tone mapping exposure value

states.name: after_check_11
states.description: Saturation slider modifies a saturation uniform or color correction parameter in the post-process chain

states.name: after_check_12
states.description: The WebGL renderer is active with tone mapping enabled and the canvas is rendering at a reasonable size

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["pool","multi","asset","postprocess"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Pool scene is loaded and a mesh with pool geometry or material is present in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["carbon","fibre","fiber","overlay"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Carbon fibre overlay texture is loaded and applied to a screen-space quad or post-process pass
Bloom post-processing pass exists and has a configurable strength/intensity property
Chromatic aberration post-process effect is present with an adjustable offset parameter
Slider UI controls exist for bloom, chromatic aberration, vignette, exposure, and saturation (at least 5 range inputs)
Adjusting the bloom slider updates bloom pass strength and inversely adjusts vignette strength (energy conservation law)
Carbon fibre overlay opacity toggle or slider exists and changing it modifies the overlay material opacity
Undo button exists and clicking it reverts the last slider change
Redo button exists and clicking it re-applies a previously undone change
Tone-mapping exposure slider changes the renderer tone mapping exposure value
Saturation slider modifies a saturation uniform or color correction parameter in the post-process chain
The WebGL renderer is active with tone mapping enabled and the canvas is rendering at a reasonable size

_conversion_note: Converted from legacy checks[] format. check.script references to window.scene/window.__scene replaced with window.__3D_STATE__.__scene. Models must expose scene object via window.__3D_STATE__.__scene = scene.
_patch_note: behavioral-contract check expression rewritten from legacy checks[] using semantic rules. State fields not yet precisely constrained. Pending step3 standardization.
